M1_TWO_SEGMENT.definition: K(t) = pA on [0, T/2), pB on [T/2, T] (boundary at the grid node nearest T/2)
M1_TWO_SEGMENT.physics: arc-wise constant scale factor: the deterministic batch analogue of a stochastic scale factor with ~half-arc (~14.7 h) correlation time (S2); variable area (S1)

M2_LINEAR_DRIFT.definition: K(t) = p0 + p1 s(t), s(t) = (t - T/2)/(T/2) in [-1, 1], realised as a staircase constant on each 90 s grid interval at the interval-midpoint value (differs from the exact ramp by <= h/T ~ 8.5e-4 in s)
params: p1 [m^2/kg, K change from mid-arc to arc end]
M2_LINEAR_DRIFT.physics: first-order Taylor term of ANY slow K(t) variation over the arc (variable area, beta-angle evolution); mechanism-agnostic

M3_THREE_SEGMENT.definition: K(t) = pA, pB, pC on equal thirds (boundaries at nodes nearest T/3, 2T/3)
M3_THREE_SEGMENT.role: complexity escalation: does one more degree of freedom add information or split it

decision.A: ALTERNATIVE_K_PARAMETERIZATION_ADDS_DISTINGUISHABLE_DIRECTIONS: any model DISTINGUISHABLE; recommend the lowest-dimension one (tie: M1 before M2)
decision.complexity_test: SPLITS_WEAK_DIRECTION if median s_var_min(M3) < median s_var_min(M1) on PRIMARY
decision.nonlinear_confirmation: may be recommended only under A; never started

per_model_on_PRIMARY.INT: fraction of feasible HF cells with max |corr| <= 0.90
per_model_on_PRIMARY.VAR: fraction of feasible HF cells with s_var_min >= 0.35

decision.stochastic_followup: justified only if B or A shows variation directions with VAR >= 0.10

dynamics.CONTROL: SIMPLIFIED phase17_r1od2_core.propagate_nom48, diagnostic only, never decides

forbidden: changing candidates, scaling or thresholds after results
k_semantics: production a_SRP = K * P(d) * nu * r_hat / |r|, K = C_R A/m [m^2/kg] constant (lunar_od.srp.srp_acceleration_kernel); dx/dK from propagate_state_with_k_sensitivity (F1 A matrix)

LITERATURE_RESULT: S1 s6.3: SRP variations due to variable spacecraft area are time-dependent dynamical errors (arc-length choice 36 h vs 60 h)
S2: operations model the SRP scale factor as a stochastic process (Vasicek better than Gauss-Markov); C_R is not treated as a well-observed static constant
S1 s6.2: consistent cannonball C_R estimation fails in full-Sun periods
literature.REPOSITORY_HYPOTHESIS: a deterministic low-dimensional time variation of K (batch analogue of a stochastic scale factor) carries measurement directions that the six-state initial condition and the constant K cannot reproduce
literature.source_contract: docs/phase17_geo_literature_contract.md (S1 Slojkowski NTRS 20140008968, S2 Slojkowski-Lowe-Woodburn ISSFD 2015; full text read in GEO)

cases.RPD_D1FREE: PRIMARY: range + counted Doppler, one free constant bias per pass (CD1 D1)
cases.RPD_D1P1E-4: secondary: per-pass bias with 1e-4 m/s prior

measurements.d23: design/partials only; CD1 closure showed D23 moves f_perp <= 4e-10
measurements.doppler: CD1 rows: ALL_VISIBLE, Tc 60 s, 90 s cadence, sigma 1e-4 m/s structural
measurements.range: CD1 range block (production two-way range, DSN3, sigma 5 m, no range nuisance)

metrics.conditioned: SVD of B = P_perp H_p (declared fractional-K basis): singular values, condition, weakest combination; sigma and correlations from the QR of B (never a normal-matrix inverse, never a rank gate)
metrics.nuisance_impact: D0 vs D1 FREE change of s_var_min and sigma
metrics.s_min / s_max: principal sines between span(H_p) and span(conditioning set = state [+ nuisance]); for M0 equals f_perp
metrics.s_var_min: smallest nonzero principal sine between span(H_p) and span(conditioning set + h_K): separation of the K-VARIATION directions from state AND the constant K

phase: 17-KP1 alternative K_SRP parameterization characterization (linear information geometry only)

population.cells: 5 orbits x 24 epochs = 120 HIGH_FIDELITY (+120 SIMPLIFIED diagnostic)

CANON.source: campaign epoch + campaign x0 (FXR canonical, GEO G0_consistent)

pre_metric_feasibility: one SIMPLIFIED cell run for anchors and timing only; no separation metric printed or inspected
question: Is there a low-dimensional, physically interpretable alternative K_SRP parameterization whose components are distinguishable from the six-state initial condition and from each other under the qualified range + counted-Doppler set?

rejected.once_per_rev_attitude_modulation: needs an attitude / multi-plate area model; production SRP is cannonball, so this would add physics (stop condition 1)
rejected.shadow_regime_dependent_K: unphysical: K is a spacecraft property; shadow is in nu
rejected.splines_high_order_polynomials: no physical basis at this arc length (brief s2)
rejected.stochastic_Gauss_Markov_Vasicek_K: physically established by S2 but deferred by the brief until deterministic block identifiability is understood

scaling.invariant_metrics: principal sines are invariant to any invertible reparameterization of the parameter block and of the state/nuisance block
scaling.parameters: fractional K: every p_j column multiplied by K_truth = 0.01 m^2/kg (1 unit = 100 % of K_truth; drift unit = K_truth change mid-arc to end)
scaling.state: phase17_r1od2_core.SCALE state part [1e6 m x3, 1e3 m/s x3]

sensitivity_construction.measurement_columns: production _two_way_range_k_srp_column (range) and two_way_counted_doppler_initial_state_jacobian with the sensitivity in the STM slot (counted Doppler), the HARDEN/F1 K construction
sensitivity_construction.method: exact composition from production quantities: J(t) = Phi(t)^-1 dx/dK(t); S_window[a,b](t) = Phi(t)(J(clip(t,a,b)) - J(a)); staircase drift = Phi(t) sum_i s_i (J_{i+1} - J_i); all boundaries on grid nodes

thresholds.internal: max |conditioned correlation| <= 0.90 INTERNALLY_SEPARATED, <= 0.99 PARTIALLY, else COLLINEAR (repository convention, declared here)
thresholds.separation: STRONG >= 0.50, MODERATE >= 0.35, else WEAK (phase17_r1od2_core.absolute_class, applied to s_var_min and s_min)

truth_level: SYNTHETIC_CAMPAIGN_TRUTH: K_truth = 0.01 m^2/kg constant; no time-varying truth is fabricated; KP1 is local distinguishability at the constant truth

verification.anchors: M0 s_min == CD1 committed f_perp (RANGE, RPD_D0, RPD_D1FREE) |diff| <= 1e-10; bank K columns == CD1 production h_k bitwise
verification.exact_oracle: CANON k = 0, 6, 12, 18 HF, RPD_D1FREE, M1-M3: exact rational Schur complement, |wrapper - exact| <= 1e-12
verification.fd_oracle: segmented HF repropagation with restarts on 2-orbit arcs (CANON k0, O2 k12), K(t) = K_truth + eps b(t), central differences eps in {1e-3, 3e-3}, rtol 1e-13: SEG2_A, SEG3_B, DRIFT vs exact composition; state-level per-column min_eps max_t ||fd - an|| / max_t ||an|| <= 1e-4; a zero-perturbation segmented run must reproduce the unsegmented propagation
verification.independent_rebuild: every HF cell, every case x model: principal sines by lstsq residual + generalized eigenproblem, |diff| <= 1e-8
